original.target_description: Relationship between bingeing and goal conflict. Original main SEM, standardized path, summer 2017 online survey; not a total effect or zero-order correlation.

n.sample_role: Individuals watching televised series at least monthly, used to test hypotheses with SEM
n.exclusions: Not documented in the acquired preprint.
n.quote: The hypotheses were tested with an online survey among N = 499 individuals

replication.target_description: Relationship between bingeing and goal conflict. Adjusted replication Model 1, standardized SEM path, June 2020 online sample; not extension model.

n.sample_role: Participants in the final cross-sectional survey SEM sample
n.exclusions: Removed participants younger than 14, watching series less than monthly, and/or providing invalid entries; 782 initially participated.
n.quote: The final nonrepresentative sample consisted of 668 respondents

reported_success.quote: We replicated the results from Granow et al. (2018) partially.

notes: Titles verified against supplied references. Acquired versions use different pagination from supplied locators; relationships independently matched. Replication uses adapted measures and adjusted Model 1. Figure 2 values in parentheses are original-study comparisons; unparenthesized values are replication. Unprinted exact p values are null; absence of a star is not converted into a numeric bound. Reported success is the authors’ overall partial-replication verdict, not an inferred effect-specific classification.
